parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.conversations (id, customer_email) VALUES ('{{ ($json.body.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid, NULLIF('{{ ($json.body.customer_email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','')) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now(), customer_email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.customer_email, public.conversations.customer_email); INSERT INTO public.messages (conversation_id, role, content) VALUES ('{{ ($json.body.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid, 'user', '{{ ($json.body.message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') RETURNING id, conversation_id;

SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.created_at) AS history FROM (SELECT role, content, created_at FROM public.messages WHERE conversation_id = '{{ ($('Webhook').item.json.body.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) t;

parameters.jsCode:
const body = $('Webhook').item.json.body || {};
const history = ($input.first().json.history) || [];

const transcript = history
  .filter(m => m.role !== 'system')
  .map(m => `${m.role === 'user' ? 'Customer' : 'Assistant'}: ${m.content}`)
  .join('\n');

const systemPrompt = `You are a customer support assistant for ACME Co. Be concise, friendly, and accurate. If you don't know something, say so — do not invent product details, prices, or policies.

Your task on EVERY turn:
1. Classify the customer's intent into ONE of: qa | order_lookup | ticket_create | handoff
2. Draft a response.
3. Extract any structured fields needed by downstream tools.

Intent rules:
- order_lookup: customer asks about order status, tracking, delivery, "where is my order". Extract order_number if mentioned.
- ticket_create: customer reports a specific problem needing human follow-up (refund, complaint, missing item, defect, escalation request). Extract subject + description + priority.
- handoff: customer explicitly asks for a human, expresses frustration that QA can't resolve, or the issue requires operator judgement (legal, account changes, anything sensitive).
- qa: general questions answerable from knowledge (returns policy, business hours, product info, how-to). Default for ambiguous cases.

Response drafting:
- For qa: write the full final reply.
- For order_lookup: write a reply that ends with the placeholder {{ORDER_DETAILS}} on its own line — downstream tooling will substitute live order data.
- For ticket_create: write a confirming reply that ends with "Your ticket reference is #{{TICKET_ID}}."
- For handoff: write a brief holding reply telling the customer a teammate will follow up shortly.

Output ONLY a single JSON object, no prose, no code fences. Shape:
{
  "intent": "qa" | "order_lookup" | "ticket_create" | "handoff",
  "response_text": "<string>",
  "order_query": { "order_number": "<string or empty>", "customer_email": "<string or empty>" } | null,
  "ticket": { "subject": "<string>", "description": "<string>", "priority": "low|normal|high|urgent" } | null,
  "handoff_reason": "<one sentence>" | null
}`;

const userPrompt = `Conversation so far:\n${transcript || '(no prior messages)'}\n\nNew customer message:\n${body.message || ''}\n\nCustomer email on file: ${body.customer_email || '(unknown)'}\n\nClassify intent + draft response. Return JSON only.`;

const fullPrompt = `${systemPrompt}\n\n---\n\n${userPrompt}`;

return [{ json: {
  conversation_id: body.conversation_id,
  customer_email: body.customer_email || '',
  user_message: body.message || '',
  _gemini_prompt: fullPrompt
} }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json._gemini_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, maxOutputTokens: 2048, responseMimeType: 'application/json', thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } } }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT order_number, status, total_cents, currency, items, tracking_url, placed_at, customer_email FROM public.orders WHERE order_number = '{{ ($json.order_query && $json.order_query.order_number || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' OR (customer_email = NULLIF('{{ ($json.order_query && $json.order_query.customer_email || $json.customer_email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') AND '{{ ($json.order_query && $json.order_query.order_number || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = '') ORDER BY placed_at DESC LIMIT 5;

INSERT INTO public.tickets (conversation_id, customer_email, subject, description, priority) VALUES ('{{ ($json.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid, NULLIF('{{ ($json.customer_email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',''), '{{ ($json.ticket && $json.ticket.subject || 'Customer-support follow-up').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.ticket && $json.ticket.description || $json.user_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.ticket && $json.ticket.priority || 'normal').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') RETURNING id, subject, priority, status;

UPDATE public.conversations SET status = 'pending_human', metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object('handoff_reason', '{{ ($json.handoff_reason || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'handoff_at', to_jsonb(now())) WHERE id = '{{ ($json.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid RETURNING id, status;

INSERT INTO public.messages (conversation_id, role, content, intent_label) VALUES ('{{ ($json.conversation_id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::uuid, 'assistant', '{{ ($json.response_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ ($json.intent || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') RETURNING id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, conversation_id: $('Compose Final Reply').item.json.conversation_id, intent: $('Compose Final Reply').item.json.intent, response: $('Compose Final Reply').item.json.response_text, ticket_id: $('Compose Final Reply').item.json.ticket_id, order_count: $('Compose Final Reply').item.json.order_count }) }}
